title: A novel fluorescent nanoprobe based on DNA silver nanoclusters for the detection of DEQ
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43645-43650
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04006J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuxia Li, Xingxing Liu, Baozhu Zhang, Fengtao Gao
A novel turn-off fluorescent nanoprobe for DEQ was constructed based on DNA-AgNCs, with the turn-off fluorescence being due to electron transfer from the DNA-AgNCs to DEQ.
